27:t_1:88.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You've been frozen like that for ten minutes... Is writing down your future plans really that hard?」

27:t_1:90.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Well... you can just put something down for now. You can always change it later.)

27:t_1:91.en:
$$宗介$$
(I cannot even decide on something for now...)

27:t_1:92.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I think anything would do. College, a job...)

27:t_1:93.en:
$$宗介$$
(I do not really understand any of those options... To write something I do not understand...)

27:t_1:94.en:
$n
「Hurry up, $$宗介$$. Morning homeroom is about to start.」

27:t_1:95.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What did you put on your form, $n?」

27:t_1:97.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So, a 《$$ビーストハンター$$》?」

27:t_1:99.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But... that would mean leaving Japan, wouldn't it?」

27:t_1:100.en:
$n
「Probably. Most Beast sightings are in North America.」

27:t_1:101.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What will you do about 《$$ナースさん$$》?」

27:t_1:104.en:
$n
「Lately... I haven't been able to reach her much.」

27:t_1:105.en:
$$かなめ$$
「W-well, it can't be helped. Nurses seem pretty busy.」

27:t_1:106.en:
$$宗介$$
「Someone may be jamming the signal.」

27:t_1:107.en:
$$かなめ$$
(He still has such a weird way of comforting people...)

27:t_1:108.en:
$n
「...It's fine. I'll visit the hospital after school.」

27:t_1:109.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh, I heard 《$$シンヤ#keyword$$》 and 《$$ミサコ#keyword$$》 got out of the hospital. Are you keeping in touch with them?」

27:t_1:110.en:
$n
「...There's no need. If they're free of the 《$$血塗られた眼$$》, that's all that matters.」

27:t_1:112.en:
$$アルト$$
「$n and the rest of us are done. Hurry up, $$宗介$$.」

27:t_1:114.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「I get how you feel, $$相良$$. With that $$新地球皇国$$ throwing its weight around, who can think about the future?」

27:t_1:115.en:
$$恭子$$
「Yeah. We need the Federation Forces to try harder.」

27:t_1:116.en:
$$アルト$$
(They fear a panic, so civilians far from the front aren't told the truth about the $$新地球皇国$$ or how the war is going...)

27:t_1:117.en:
$$甲児$$
(The war is still something far away to the people in Japan...)

27:t_1:120.en:
$$恵理$$
「All right, everyone. Take your seats.」

27:t_1:121.en:
$$スズネ$$
「None of the Volunteer Club members are absent, either.」

27:t_1:122.en:
$$恭子$$
「It's been a while, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

27:t_1:123.en:
$$詩織$$
「Thank you for all your work with the Volunteer Club.」

27:t_1:124.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you. I'm relieved to see you're all doing well.」

27:t_1:125.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「There's one guy breaking out in a cold sweat, though.」

27:t_1:127.en:
$$恵理$$
「Your future plans form... It's admirable that you're thinking so seriously about your future.」

27:t_1:128.en:
$$宗介$$
「I intend to give it my all...」

27:t_1:130.en:
$$恵理$$
「Whose phone is that? School rules say to turn your phones off while you're here.」

27:t_1:131.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry, ma'am. I, $$早乙女アルト$$, need to leave early for family reasons.」

27:t_1:132.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You'd be nervous going alone, $$アルト$$. I'll come too.」

27:t_1:133.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'll get my bike. $$さやか$$, call a taxi.」

27:t_1:134.en:
$$さやか$$
「All right. $$ボス$$, you and the guys bring everyone's bags.」

27:t_1:137.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Miss $$神楽坂$$...! I'll go find out what's going on!」

27:t_1:140.en:
$$宗介$$
「I will submit my future plans form as promptly as possible.」

27:t_1:142.en:
$$恭子$$
「In the end, the whole Volunteer Club left...」

27:t_2:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「You needn't tell me. The unit we sent to $$第２新東京市$$ was wiped out, wasn't it?」

27:t_2:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I never expected them to win. Even against our opponents in their current state.」

27:t_2:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「But we achieved our objective.」

27:t_2:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「My own declaration of war. Against $$テレサ$$ and them.」

27:t_2:10.en:
$$レナード$$
(My preparations will soon be complete... Once they're done, I'll go get her.)

27:t_2:11.en:
$$レナード$$
(I'd prefer a rainy day.)

27:t_2:18.en:
$$宗介$$
「I apologize for failing to submit my future plans form by today's deadline.」

27:t_2:19.en:
$$恵理$$
「You couldn't help it. Miss $$西条$$ told me you got caught in a battle while chasing after $$早乙女#macross$$.」

27:t_2:20.en:
$$恵理$$
「I'm glad things worked out for $$早乙女#macross$$ too. I heard his father collapsed, but it seems it wasn't serious.」

27:t_2:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yes... $$アルト$$ also asked me to tell you he was sorry to have worried you.」

27:t_2:22.en:
$$宗介$$
「Although it is informal, I would like to report my future plans verbally.」

27:t_2:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「My goal for the future is to graduate from this $$陣代高校$$. That is all.」

27:t_2:25.en:
$$恵理$$
「Well... $$相良$$... What I want to know is what you plan to do after that...」

uncertain: 27:t_2:10: Her refers to Kaname, whom Leonard intends to collect; the preceding Teresa is the addressee of his declaration, not this pronoun.
27:t_1:90-93: Parentheses preserved for private dialogue even though these are spoken asides.
